cs.t: I bought a pair of 1964 Ears quad-driver in-ear monitors for my band, and I ended up using them EVERYWHERE - when at work (open-plan office, ugh), when traveling (plane, motorcycle, etc), even when mowing the lawn.  They're incredible, with the best sound quality I've personally ever experienced.  All the other noise just... goes away, and I don't pick up anything that doesn't come through the IEMs.
